name: alsp
description: Evidence about Rust code for agents: who calls a symbol, which tests reach it, coverage, predicted test gaps, and diff review, from the alsp command-line tool.

interface.shortDescription: Callers, tests, coverage and review for Rust code.
interface.longDescription: A skill that teaches agents the alsp command line: type-resolved references, tests that reach a symbol, observed coverage, predicted test gaps, and diff review, each answer marked resolved, observed or predicted.
